What is the mean of the values 22, 20, 19, 18, 21?
In the xy-plane, the equation of a circle is  (x + 1)^2 + (y - 4)^2 = 25. What are the coordinates of the center of the circle?
The function f is defined by  f(x) = 1x + (7). What is the value of f(-1)?
A population doubles every 4 years. If the population starts at 500, what is the population after 16 years?
What is the range of the data set 24, 40, 37, 13, 46?
Two angles of a triangle measure 58 degrees and 36 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: Sum of triangle angles is 180: 58 + 36 + c = 180; c = 86.

questions.question: Which of the following describes all values of x satisfying  -7 <= 2x + (3) <= 1?
questions.explanation: Subtract (3) from each part: -10 <= 2x <= -2; divide by 2: -5 <= x <= -1.

questions.question: What are the solutions to the equation  |2x + (2)| = 4?
A bag contains 6 red, 4 blue, and 4 green marbles. If a marble is selected at random, what is the probability that it is NOT blue?
Two angles of a triangle measure 25 degrees and 67 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: Sum of triangle angles is 180: 25 + 67 + c = 180; c = 88.

questions.question: If  5x + 6 = 36, what is the value of x?
What is the y-intercept of the graph of  y = 1x^2 + (5)x + (4)  in the xy-plane?
What is the median of the data set 43, 8, 48, 4, 32?
In the xy-plane, the equation of a circle is  (x + 3)^2 + (y - 2)^2 = 16. What is the radius of this circle?
questions.explanation: Compare to (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2; r^2 = 16, so r = 4.

questions.question: Which of the following points satisfies the inequality  y > -2x + (4)?
A population doubles every 5 years. If the population starts at 1000, what is the population after 15 years?
What is the mean of the values 15, 17, 16, 13, 14?
What is the volume of a rectangular box with dimensions 4 by 10 by 11?
Which equation represents the line in the xy-plane that is parallel to  y = -2x + (-5)  and passes through (0, 5)?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines share slope (-2); the y-intercept is given as 5.

questions.question: The polynomial  p(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + (-3)x + k  has  (x - 4)  as a factor. What is the value of k?
Which of the following describes all values of x satisfying  -6 <= 4x + (2) <= 18?
questions.explanation: Subtract (2) from each part: -8 <= 4x <= 16; divide by 4: -2 <= x <= 4.

questions.question: The polynomial  p(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + (1)x + k  has  (x - 2)  as a factor. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: By the factor theorem, p(2) = 0: 8 + 4(4) + (1)(2) + k = 0; k = -26.

questions.question: What is the slope of a line in the xy-plane that is perpendicular to the line  y = (-1/3)x + -4?
questions.explanation: The perpendicular slope is the negative reciprocal of -1/3, which is 3.

questions.question: What are the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of  y = -2(x - (6))^2 + (-4)  in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: Vertex form y = a(x - h)^2 + k has vertex (h, k) = (6, -4).

questions.question: For what value of k does the equation  5x + 2 = 5x + k  have infinitely many solutions?
questions.explanation: For infinitely many solutions, both sides must be identical, so k = 2.

questions.question: The polynomial  p(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 + (-5)x + k  has  (x - 2)  as a factor. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: By the factor theorem, p(2) = 0: 8 + 2(4) + (-5)(2) + k = 0; k = -6.

questions.question: Which value of x satisfies the equation  3(x - 6) = 1x + -12?
What are the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of  y = -2(x - (-3))^2 + (-4)  in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: Vertex form y = a(x - h)^2 + k has vertex (h, k) = (-3, -4).

questions.question: A student wants an average of at least 90 across 3 tests, each scored out of 100. So far the student's combined score on the first 2 tests is 173. Which inequality represents the score t the student must achieve on the final test to meet the goal?
The polynomial  p(x) = x^3 + 3x^2 + (3)x + k  has  (x - 5)  as a factor. What is the value of k?
Which of the following points satisfies the inequality  y < -1x + (-3)?
What are the coordinates of the vertex of the graph of  y = -1(x - (6))^2 + (8)  in the xy-plane?
questions.explanation: Vertex form y = a(x - h)^2 + k has vertex (h, k) = (6, 8).

questions.question: The function f is defined by  f(x) = 5x + (5). For what value of x is  f(x) = 25?
What is the minimum value of  f(x) = 3(x - (2))^2 + (-10)?
questions.explanation: The minimum occurs when (x - 2)^2 = 0, giving f = -10.
